units.source_text: 今天游览车异常拥挤，几无隙地。

en.t: Today the sightseeing carriages were unusually crowded, with almost no space left.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想停车在马场殿旁边，然而没有适当的地方。

en.t: Prince Genji wanted to stop his carriage beside the riding-ground pavilion, but there was no suitable place.

units.source_text: 他说：“这地方公卿的车子很多，太嘈杂了。”

en.t: He said, "There are many courtiers' carriages here, and it is far too noisy."

units.source_text: 正在踌躇不决之际，忽见近旁停着一辆很漂亮的女车，里面乘着许多女子，衣袖和裙裾露出在帘下。

en.t: While he was hesitating, he suddenly noticed a very elegant ladies' carriage stopped nearby, with many women inside, their sleeves and skirt hems showing beneath the blinds.

units.source_text: 其中有一人从车中伸出一把扇子来，向公子的随从人招呼道：“停在这里好不好？

en.t: One of them reached a fan out from the carriage and called to the prince's attendants, "Would it be all right to stop here?
We will make room for you."

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“多么轻狂的女子啊！”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "What a frivolous woman!"

units.source_text: 然而这地方的确很好，便命令驱车过去，对那女车中的人说：“你们怎么会找到这好地方？

en.t: But the place really was excellent, so he ordered his carriage driven over and said to the women in that carriage, "How did you manage to find such a good spot?

units.source_text: 便接了那把扇子，展开来一看，上面题着诗句：

en.t: Then he took the fan, opened it, and saw that a poem had been written on it:
